newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's sees no major Canada fallout.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's sees no major Canada fallout.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday it did not expect the outcome of the dispute involving its 40 percent owned Molson Breweries with Coors Brewing Co to have a severe impact on the group's bottom line
"I don't expect it to have any severe impact, if you like, on the abnormals," Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel told reporters after the brewer released its half year result.
Molson and Coor's were discussing a new licensing deal after a court ruling terminated their previous arrangement under which Molsen brewed and marketed Coors beer brands in Canada.
Kunkel said it would be virtually impossible to estimate what the final damages bill to Foster's would be from the Molson-Coors talks.
"Any arrangement going forward that is negotiated with Coors is likely to be less profitable than any arrangement we had formally in the past," Kunkel said.
Foster's must compensate for the likely drop in earnings from the expected new Coors arrangement by aggressively trying to ramp up Molson's profits, he said.
